# Voice {#sec-voice}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "voice AI is a different technology" — it is transcribe,
think, speak: a loop around the chat loop you already understand.

Installs: `hands_on_ai.voice`, transcription and synthesis as plain
calls, latency as the real engineering problem. Working build: a
talk-out-loud chatbot, three calls stitched together.
:::
